guitar.notes: Iconic, extremely well-documented pairing: Angus's Gibson SG and Malcolm's Gretsch (Jet Firebird/Gretsch 6131) rhythm guitar are core to AC/DC's image.

tone.target: dry Angus-style crunchy Marshall riff with bright upper mids
tone.profile: dry Angus-style crunchy Marshall riff with bright upper mids
tone.summary: A punchy signal chain featuring a Boost for attack, followed by an AC30 TB amp model paired with the UK Vintage 4x12 cabinet to deliver the required crunchy, mid-focused tone.
corrections: main riff is crunchy, not fuzzed
wah is not a core element

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise from the guitar signal.
Provide tight, aggressive attack and boost the signal into the amp for maximum crunch.
Add the necessary crunchy grit and bite without resorting to heavy fuzz or high gain.
blocks.gap: The GP-180 lacks a dedicated Plexi/Marshall model, so OD 9 is used for classic British rock crunch.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic British tone required for AC/DC's Marshall-style sound, emphasizing upper mids and brightness.
Provide the classic British cabinet sound and frequency response matching Marshall gear.
Fine-tune the tone to achieve bright upper mids and punchy articulation required for 'Thunderstruck' riffs.
Disabled as the target tone requires a dry, punchy sound without modulation effects.
Disabled to maintain the dry, aggressive attack required for the main riff.
Add minimal natural room ambience to prevent the tone from sounding too sterile, while keeping it punchy.
blocks.gap: The verdict specifies 'dry', so reverb is kept very low (15%) and only used for subtle depth.

blocks.purpose: Final output level adjustment to match the desired performance volume.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better Plexi/Marshall cabinet realism.

proposals.reason: Better emulates the specific Marshall Plexi sound required for AC/DC's crunch.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased realism and bite in upper mids.
